name: Reytd Reviews for WooCommerce
author: reytd

sections.description:
Reytd emails your customers after their order has shipped, asking them to review what they bought, and shows the reviews and star ratings on your product pages.

This plugin connects your WooCommerce shop to your Reytd store:

  • Sends your products, and your orders as they’re paid, refunded, cancelled and shipped, in the background.
  • Shows Reytd’s stars and reviews on your product pages, in classic and block themes, in place of WooCommerce’s own reviews.
  • Blocks and shortcodes ([reytd_stars], [reytd_reviews], [reytd_carousel]) to place the widgets anywhere.

You need a Reytd account, which is free to start: sign up at reytd.com/register. Nothing is sent to Reytd until you connect the plugin to your account.

External services

This plugin connects to Reytd (reytd.com), a product review service, to collect and show your shop’s reviews. Nothing is sent until you connect the plugin to your Reytd account, and disconnecting stops it.

  • Reytd’s API (reytd.com/api): when you connect, the plugin checks your token and reads your store’s name and settings. From then on, whenever a product or a paid order changes, it sends Reytd the product’s id, name, SKU, address and image, and the order’s id, number and date (and when it was cancelled, if it was), the customer’s email address, name and language, and the products ordered. When the order ships, it sends which products shipped and when, with the shipment’s carrier, tracking number and tracking link when the order has them. When products are refunded, it sends which ones and when, as returns. Prices, addresses, phone numbers and payment details are never sent. Reytd uses this to email the customer a review request after their order ships, and shows the order, its shipments and its returns to you in your Reytd account. Each request also says which versions of the plugin, WordPress and WooCommerce sent it.
  • Reytd’s widgets (widgets.reytd.com, or sandbox-widgets.reytd.com when connected with a sandbox token): pages that show Reytd’s stars, reviews or carousel load Reytd’s widget script and the product’s reviews from there, which receives the visitor’s IP address and browser details, as any website does. The widget sets no cookies. It reports anonymous counts of how often widgets are shown and clicked (which widget and which product, for a sample of visits, with nothing that identifies the visitor), for your widget statistics in Reytd. On Reytd’s Free plan, the widgets include a “Powered by Reytd” link to reytd.com.

Reytd’s terms: reytd.com/terms
Reytd’s privacy policy: reytd.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. It needs WooCommerce.
  2. In Reytd, create an account if you don’t have one, then go to Developer › API tokens and create a Live token that can send products and orders.
  3. In WordPress, go to WooCommerce › Settings › Reytd, paste the token and click Connect. Your products and the last 30 days’ paid orders are sent to Reytd in the background.
  4. In Reytd, under Review requests, add a reply-to address and turn review requests on. Only orders that ship after that get one.

On a block theme, the stars and reviews are placed in the single product template by themselves; move or remove them in Appearance › Editor. On a classic theme, choose where they go under WooCommerce › Settings › Reytd › Widgets.

The full guide: Product reviews for WooCommerce on reytd.com.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Reytd account?

Yes. The plugin connects your shop to Reytd, which sends the review requests and keeps the reviews. Reytd has a free plan.

Will connecting email my past customers?

No. Review requests are off until you turn them on in Reytd, and only orders that ship after that get one.

Does it slow down my checkout or product pages?

No call to Reytd is made while a customer shops or checks out: everything is sent afterwards, in the background, with WooCommerce’s own job queue. On product pages, Reytd’s widget script loads without blocking the page.

When does an order count as shipped?

When it’s fulfilled with WooCommerce’s own fulfillments, when a tracking number is added with the Shipment Tracking or Advanced Shipment Tracking plugin, or otherwise when the order is completed.

What happens when I refund an order?

Refunded products aren’t asked about in the review request, whether the customer sent them back or kept them. A refund that lists products is sent to Reytd as a return, also when the order hadn’t shipped yet, and so is a product line’s money refunded without a quantity. A refund of an amount only, or of shipping or a fee, changes nothing: the products are asked about as usual. A whole order refunded is cancelled in Reytd, and a refund you delete brings its products back. It works with any returns plugin that refunds through WooCommerce. When in doubt, Reytd doesn’t ask: if a return can’t be sent, the order’s review request is cancelled. The full story: refunds and returns in the guide.

What happens to my existing WooCommerce reviews?

They stay in WooCommerce, but aren’t shown while Reytd’s reviews replace them. To show WooCommerce’s as well, turn off the replacement under WooCommerce › Settings › Reytd › Widgets. They aren’t copied to Reytd.

Can I try it on a staging site?

Yes. Connect with a sandbox token (rytd_test_…): everything goes to your Reytd store’s sandbox, whose emails are simulated, and never reaches your real customers.

Can I remove the “Powered by Reytd” link?

Yes, on Reytd’s Growth and Pro plans. On the Free plan, the reviews widget and the stars include a small link to Reytd.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Refunded products are sent to Reytd as returns, so their customers aren’t asked about them, and orders keep the quantities ordered. Orders already in Reytd with a refund are sent again once.
  • A line by an order’s refunds, and on the settings page, says how refunds count.
  • Developers can send returns of their own with the reytd_send_return action.

1.0.1

  • The guide’s link in the readme and as the Plugin URI, links in the readme, and the reply-to address that review requests need.

1.0.0

  • The first stable release, the same as 0.1.0 with screenshots.

0.1.0

  • Connecting by token, syncing products, orders and shipments, the widgets, and the privacy policy text.
